name: worktrunk
description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
one_liner: A command-line tool that makes it painless to run several AI coding agents on the same project at once, each in its own isolated copy of the code.
buyer: A developer or small team running multiple AI coding agents in parallel on the same codebase who's tired of manual git-worktree bookkeeping.
business_use_cases: A solo developer runs five different Claude Code tasks in parallel overnight, each in its own worktree, and reviews the diffs in the morning.
A dev-tooling vendor bundles it into a larger 'AI agent fleet management' product as the underlying worktree engine.
An engineering team standardizes it so everyone's parallel-agent workflow produces consistent, mergeable branches instead of ad hoc scripts.

money_ideas.idea: A paid team dashboard that visualizes all active worktrunk worktrees and their agent status across a company.

steal_this: This is a pure developer-productivity tool — the realistic weekend project is a thin UI on top showing a live board of which worktree and agent is doing what, not a separate standalone business.
